def bounded_containers(data):
    # The published row/operation/block maxima imply fewer than300000
    # containers in every valid request. Reject larger malformed structures
    # before allocating an unrestricted JSON object graph.
    depth = count = fields = 0
    quoted = False
    last_slash = -2
    odd_slashes = False
    for token in re.finditer(rb'[":\\\[\]{}]',data):
        at = token.start()
        char = data[at]
        if quoted:
            if char==92:
                odd_slashes = not odd_slashes if last_slash==at-1 else True
                last_slash = at
            elif char==34 and not (last_slash==at-1 and odd_slashes):
                quoted = False
        elif char==34:
            quoted = True
        elif char==58:
            # At most 45157 object fields can occur in a valid schema.
            # This prevents a malformed giant object from first allocating
            # millions of pairs in the strict duplicate-key decoder.
            fields += 1
            require(fields <= 50000)
        elif char in (91,123):
            depth += 1
            count += 1
            require(depth<=32 and count<=300000)
        elif char in (93,125):
            depth -= 1
            require(depth>=0)


def read_request(stream):
    data = stream.read(MAX_BYTES+1)
    require(len(data)<=MAX_BYTES)
    # Valid schemas have fewer than 2.8 million commas (including every
    # coordinate and operation). Bound malformed scalar arrays before decoding.
    require(data.count(b',') <= 3000000)
    bounded_containers(data)
    return validate(json.loads(data.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=unique, parse_constant=constant, parse_float=constant))
